purpose: Teach: 会計士/生み出さ/染色/カスタム/補修/公約/不透明/枚数

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究も、会計士のように、緻密さ、求められるぞ。
lines.en: Ren — research demands the same precision you'd find in accounting work.
lines.style: Measured, professorial. Slight pause after the name — not harsh, but establishing attention. Voice steady and even. Teaching tone without condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室で、新たな仮説、生み出されました、最近。
lines.en: Yes. We've generated a new hypothesis in the lab recently.
lines.style: Quiet respect in the affirmative. Slight uptick on the substantive part — wanting to show he's thought it through. Careful, not over-eager. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 伝統染色業界の研究、現代に、活かせるテーマだぞ。
lines.en: That's a strong thesis — traditional dyeing industry research with modern application potential.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the voice. Clear, direct. The tone of someone recognising good work without making a ceremony of it. Brief, purposeful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置、カスタム仕様で、製作中です。
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently building custom laboratory equipment for the experiments.
lines.style: Small pride beneath the formality. Slight emphasis on 'custom' — showing he understands the difficulty. Slower pace on the technical part, to show competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の補修、何度も、繰り返せ、初校から。
lines.en: Draft your paper carefully, then revise it thoroughly from the beginning — multiple times.
lines.style: Firmer instruction. Not unkind, but the voice of someone who's seen careless first drafts. Slight weight on 'multiple times' — not punishment, but insistence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官への公約、研究計画、守ってまいります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll honour my commitment to my adviser and stick to the research plan.
lines.style: Solemn, almost formal commitment. Steady, no wavering. The voice of someone making a promise to himself first, the adviser second.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手研究者、先行き、不透明な時代、覚悟を持て。
lines.en: Young researchers have to be prepared — the future isn't guaranteed.
lines.style: Shift to something deeper — not harsh, but real. Weight on the second sentence. Slower pace. The voice of someone who's watched careers and knows what's at stake.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文ページの枚数、適切に、調整いたします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll adjust the paper length to the proper specifications.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly smaller in energy. Not defeated — competent. The voice of someone getting the practical details right and moving forward.
